mapper.select: select cbt.batch_id, cbt.batch_code, cbt.refresh_status, cbt.refresh_date, cbt.factory_id, cbt.manufacturer_id, cbt.object_version_number, cbt.request_id, cbt.program_id, cbt.created_by, to_char(cbt.creation_date,'yyyy-mm-dd') as creat_date, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id=cbt.created_by) as user_name, (select hm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hm where hm.bp_id =cbt.manufacturer_id) as manufacturer_name, (select hm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hm where hm.bp_id =cbt.factory_id) as factory_name from con_confirm_batch_temp cbt where cbt.batch_id =#{batchId}
